acquisition method: LC-SRM measurements of Tau L/H peptide ratios were performed
alkylation reagent: proteins were alkylated with 100 μL 0.05 M iodoacetamide solution
alkylation concentration: proteins were alkylated with 100 μL 0.05 M iodoacetamide solution
cleavage agent: Protein mixtures were digested with 12.5 μg/ml trypsin
collision energy: MS2 scan settings: resolution 60000 @ m/z 400, AGC target 8e3, max IT 100ms, isolation window m/z 1.6, NCE 27
enrichment method: isolated from soluble fraction by MC1 antibody immunoaffinity columns
fractionation method: the latter two were fractionated by size-exclusion chromatography
instrument: quadrupole Orbitrap tandem mass spectrometer (Q Exactive, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: The PicoChip containing an emitter for nanospray ionization
labeling: Label-free quantification was done using the XIC-based in-built label-free quantification (LFQ) algorithm integrated into MaxQuant.
